_comment: Fares, keyed by bus id (the slug of the bus English name). An entry here is a fare a person decided on: either transcribed by hand from BRTA's official list (see _brta) or accepted from rider reports that agreed, via /fares/review with the admin token. A bus with no entry is shown as 'fare not verified' in the UI. NEVER invent a number here: a wrong fare sends someone to the wrong bus or makes them short of cash. The 'source' field is what keeps a rider-agreed number from being presented as if the government published it, so do not set it to 'brta' unless you actually read it off the BRTA list.

_brta.titleBn: ঢাকা মেট্রো এলাকার বাস ভাড়ার তালিকা
_brta.format: scanned PDF, 116 pages, no text layer
howTo: Open the BRTA page above in a browser and find the PDF attachment.
Read the fare for each bus you care about. Enter it as an integer taka amount.
Set verifiedAt to the date printed on the list, not the date you typed it.
Start with the 30-40 buses that carry the most people, not all 156.

_entryFormat.amount: Integer taka. Whole numbers only, no 'Tk' prefix.
_entryFormat.verifiedAt: ISO date printed on the BRTA list, not the day you typed it in.
_entryFormat.source: 'brta' for the official list, or 'community' for a rider correction.
_entryFormat.reportCount: community only: how many riders agreed on this number.
_entryFormat.sourceUrl: community only: a link to where riders said so, so anyone can check it.

_noFakeEntries: There is deliberately no example block here. A sample 'amount: 0' fare sitting in the fare file is a fabricated number one careless edit away from being served to someone, and this project does not hold invented fares anywhere. The shape is documented in _entryFormat instead, and a real entry is added by transcribing BRTA's list by hand or by accepting an agreed rider report at /fares/review.
_whyEmpty: Empty on purpose. BRTA's fare list is a scanned PDF, so no fare has been read yet, and guessing a fare is worse than admitting we do not know it. The UI shows 'ভাড়া যাচাই করা হয়নি' for every bus until this file has real entries.
